question: Can measured product endpoints and catalytic-group perturbations join the same construct/assay relation beyond aldol chemistry?
conclusion: Named reaction participants, three parent kinetic parameters and two reported activity-reduction factors can share the existing consumer. Main-text product outcomes are supported at distinct bound contexts. Matched parameter-specific mutation inference remains unqualified without the supplement.

source_access.publication_rights: Project-authored factual annotation; article bodies and images stay host-local and are not redistributed.

selection: Selected DA_20_10 kcat, KM-diene and KM-dienophile only, its two designed-group substitutions and relevant product/structure context. Three printed Table1 specificity/efficiency columns are intentionally outside this projection; they are not absent, not recomputed and this is not full-table coverage. Other designs, screen outcomes and specificity mutations are outside this bounded unscored source annotation.

matched_parameter_assessment.question: Which parameter-specific matched mutant/parent assay supports the already reported Q195E and Y121F activity reductions?
matched_parameter_assessment.scope: A missing assay/parameter qualification, not absent mutation effects or inactive enzyme. Do not replace source-reported folds with invented raw values.
matched_parameter_assessment.control_identity_status: Named mutation background; denominator measurement and exact matched assay remain unidentified.

structural_context.evidence_scope: article-described apo structure; deposit not acquired or independently inspected
structural_context.limits: No substrate-bound final-construct geometry, direct mutant geometry, observed designed hydrogen bonds or verified assay sequence. A272N, predicted to restrain Tyr conformation, is absent from the article-described crystallized construct.

mechanistic_scope.Q195: Source proposes amide hydrogen-bond interactions; Q195E activity effect does not isolate hydrogen bonding, HOMO modulation, desolvation or a calculated activation barrier.
mechanistic_scope.Y121: Y121F is consistent with loss of a hydroxyl contribution; no isolated LUMO, packing or conformational mechanism is established.

limits: No matched product conversion or stereochemical assay for Q195E/Y121F is established here.
No paper-wide absence claim; the supplement and cited analytical-reference literature are unassessed.
No exact sequence, assay-specimen identity, balanced atom map, productive geometry, independent validation, design-success rate, new experiment or evidence-tier promotion.
No equality from > bounds, no ee/dr inference, no product-share-to-conversion or mutant transfer.

reconsideration.bespoke_code: No runtime change; two reactants and substrate-specific parameter labels are data.
reconsideration.reuse: Same consumer recovers named reaction, existing-style provider joins and explicit noneligibility; no measured time saving.
reconsideration.integrated_value: Prevents reported activity fold summaries from becoming kcat/yield effects and prevents structural or stereo transfer to mismatched constructs/assays. No superiority over competent source reading or demonstrated design utility.
